props.title: What Makes Sports Massage Different from a Regular Massage?

items.question: Is Sports Massage only for professional athletes?
items.answer: No. Sports Massage is suitable for anyone with an active lifestyle, including gym-goers, runners, surfers, hikers, and people who experience muscle tightness from regular movement.

items.question: What is the difference between Sports Massage and Deep Tissue Massage?
items.answer: Both techniques may use firm pressure, but their purpose is different. Sports Massage focuses more on recovery, mobility, and the physical demands of an active lifestyle, while Deep Tissue Massage focuses on releasing deeper areas of long-term muscle tension.

items.question: Should I get Sports Massage before or after exercise?
items.answer: Both options are possible. A pre-activity session usually uses lighter techniques to prepare the body, while a post-activity session focuses more on relaxation and recovery after physical effort.

items.question: Will Sports Massage feel painful?
items.answer: Sports Massage may involve stronger pressure than a relaxation massage, but it should not feel painful. Our therapists adjust the intensity based on your comfort and body condition.

items.question: How often should I receive Sports Massage?
items.answer: The ideal frequency depends on your activity level, training schedule, and personal preference. Some active individuals enjoy regular sessions, while others book treatments after periods of increased physical demand.

items.question: How much does a sports massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: IDR 269.000 for 1 hour and IDR 359.000 for 1.5 hours per person at Spa Bali Moon. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist.

items.question: How long is a sports massage, and which should I choose?
items.answer: Sessions run 1 or 1.5 hours. One hour suits focused recovery on specific areas. Choose 1.5 hours if you want full-body recovery across several muscle groups.

props.title: Renew Your Body After Every Challenge
props.text: Training, outdoor adventures, and long days exploring Bali leave muscles tired and restricted. Sports Massage uses controlled pressure and recovery techniques to restore comfort and movement.
